limitations: Only 19 known token contracts, not all BSC universe
Full-pagination status applies to ERC20 transfer logs within 19 CAs, not full wallet lifetime transactions in other assets
Inbound/outbound equal quantity does not prove sale, PnL or owner control
Partial wallets retain null net token instead of a fabricated current token balance
ERC20 Transfer events may include fee splits and multiple logs in one transaction
CEX deposits are not confirmed exchange sale
pagination_policy: Use fromBlock last verified block (inclusive), order asc, dedup event_id; opaque Alchemy pageKey may reset to historical first page across sessions
